note: Giacomo Raspanti: San Girolamo e l’interpretazione occidentale di Gal 2,11–14. _Revue des études augustiniennes_ 49 (2003) 297–321.

_Christo confixus sum cruci_ – with Christ I am nailed to the cross. Because _configere_ in this sense does not exist in classical Latin, Richards calls this “the most curious experiment in language.” – George C. Richards: _A Concise Dictionary to the Vulgate New Testament_. London 1934 (xvi, 130 pp.), p. viii.
